messages:
maria: FYI saw NaNs in prod for rwd-nano-8q after the 02:10 UTC deploy. Spike correlates with KV cache size > 64 entries, paged-attn path looks involved. Perf counters report softmax overflow warnings.

jon: can you repro locally and grab a perf trace?

maria: repro command i used: `python -m tests.attn_repro --model rwd-nano-8q --seq 2048 --kv 70 --runs 30` — attaching the quick profile from perf-bot.

perf-bot: uploaded profile: https://perf.internal/runs/2105554321/flamegraph.html (2.1MB) — summary: kernel-selector -> paged_attn_fallback triggered 92% of calls at seq>=1024; softmax_confidence: many large logits leading to infs.

ravi: quick read — selector chooses paged fallback when tile mismatch + kv pages > 1. Our fp8 quant path doesn't apply the bias/scale pre-shift before softmax, so exponent overflow is plausible. Might be missing the logit rescale step used in fused_flash variant.

ana: any quick mitigation we can deploy?

maria: temporary test: `FORCE_KERNEL=flash_fused_1 python -m tests.attn_repro ...` — with fused kernel forced, NaNs disappear, latency +8ms p50 but stable.

ravi: sounds like a kernel-selection heuristic bug. Two immediate options: 1) prefer fused_flash for fp8-quant models when kv_len > 32, 2) add defensive clamp to softmax logits (eg clamp to [-30,30]) in paged path. Option 1 lower risk for numeric correctness, option 2 cheap but may mask root cause.

jon: please open an infra ticket, but also add a tiny unit that seeds logits to produce overflow (random.seed(42) with scaled logits) and run under CI with FP8 enabled. We need deterministic repro tests.

ana: created draft PR with selector guard: `if model.quant=="fp8" and kv_len>32: prefer_kernel = fused_flash` — PR link: https://git.redwood/infr/PR/4923 (draft). Also adding a scoped clamp in paged path behind a feature flag.

maria: confirmed local perf: forcing fused removes NaNs. Running broader load test now.

jon: followups: (a) add unit test and CI matrix entry for fp8+paged, (b) add telemetry to count kernel switches when quantized, (c) consider a tiny stable-softmax that uses log-sum-exp defensively in fp8 path.

ravi: I'll own telemetry + regression test. ana, can you review PR 4923?

ana: on it, adding comments around tradeoffs in selector cost model.

maria: opened issue INFR-3242 with timeline and links to perf report, PR, and repro. I'll keep monitoring prod for further NaN reports and post updates here. :eyes:
